reviewer_boundary: Independent direction review; did not author this design or the frozen provider/core/helper. No producer files changed.

findings.finding: One separately versioned native owner embeds the unchanged canonical c585 registry and uses the actual same job lease and independently held descriptor/preparation cohort. No external manager cast, stolen lease, duplicated registry, separately fabricated storage or detach/adopt API is permitted. Exactly one installed owner per physical domain remains a trusted platform obligation.

Frozen helper002 explicitly identifies79 and directly pins/configures79. Design correctly requires a new source/profile/bridge/receipt binding for the new owner and full actual anchor including callback/context/scratch storage. It preserves old freezes and refuses the existing8-page/16-query limit if the enlarged span does not fit. Injecting a new callback into a structurally compatible old helper is not provenance.

Opaque public identifiers are resolved against the live anchor on every call and disclose no usable registry, lease, descriptor or raw view. Actual span/descriptor access is scoped inside synchronous owned_run with invocation/lease/ticket identity; outputs contain bounded values only. Trusted callbacks must not retain internal views; design explicitly declines memory-isolation/security guarantees against arbitrary privileged code.

Fixed bounded callback operations are copied once at trusted boot setup. Context is anchor-inline or independently retained with exact protected lifetime/ranges. All actual references, context, table and coordinator storage survive facade/token loss; code residency is required. Domain busy and short metadata lock prevent reentry before any native/effect callback, with callbacks outside the lock.

Same-registry, same-lease bpl_effect_begin commits pending ticket/resource history before dispatch. All private retire/complete/reset paths close immediately. One entry covers one explicitly bounded operation and conservative union of every subeffect; separately invoked independent effects require entries. No nested begin or callback before failed begin is allowed.

Return validation binds invocation/lease/generation/ticket/operation and canonical pending state before success is reported or public output committed. Failed, unknown, mismatched, replayed or changed bound identity/view halts the domain and retains actual still-owned refs/claims/preparation. Nonreturn remains busy/pending indefinitely; timeout or token drop cannot invent cleanup or start overlapping work.

Any begun effect, including reported success or no-op refusal, irreversibly prevents private retirement, completion and ref-reset. No ACTIVE, drain/free, logical-close-to-reuse or force-cleanup transition exists. Only never-exposed known-private cohorts may complete all explicit pairs, retire canonical metadata, then reset refs. Prior lost-ref uncertainty is reported honestly and permanently halts reuse.

The32 successfully begun entries are a lifetime bound for a canonical lease, not a recyclable ring. Preflight reserves a reviewed worst-case full remaining composite budget including errors; domain busy spans reserved chains. Entry33 refuses before callbacks. No reset/wrap/compaction/generation laundering is admitted; continuous submissions/IRQ service explicitly need a different durable-history design.

Planned tests explicitly join actual new adapter to original TEST-SDK stand-ins and c585 without claiming native runtime. They cover ledger-before-callback, wrong cohort/resource/view substitution, table mutation, reentry, result replay, partial failure/nonreturn,32/33 boundary, no-op retention, stale tokens, context aliases and old receipt rejection. Compiled semantic mutants and genuine target frame/build checks remain future, not passed claims.

Direction contains no implementation, activation/backend, MMIO/PTE/DART/IRQ/firmware writer or hardware proposal. Frozen79/c585/helper002 remain unchanged. No new host tests or build execution occurred in this review, and inherited validations are not regraded.

actual_source_checks.fact: Frozen79 intentionally rejects effect history; its invoke path cannot simply be reused for exposed queries or relaxed globally. The separate new owner must provide its own admitted effectful state path while preserving private gates.

Actual descriptors are retained in native-private OSPtr storage. Current public API supplies no canonical-lease/backing-view exposure bridge. A new join cannot be made through existing public APIs without a separately reviewed version.

Unchanged c585 journals pending/ever_resources before returning, bounds32 entries, clears pending only on accepted result, and refuses retirement after history even when success was reported. It does not itself invoke or order external callbacks; the proposed owned coordinator must enforce this.
Current receipt hard-binds79. New helper profile/source set and exact enlarged typed span are necessary, as now explicitly required by the design.

implementation_review_obligations: Prove actual callbacks cannot replace the canonical lease/ref cohort; expose no manager/registry/view accessor and maintain one owner installation per domain.
All old and new private-complete/reset/retire paths must reject effect reservation, pending invocation, ever-history and uncertainty; a successful logical operation may never reopen them.
Validate immutable captured ops/context lifetime and every lock/busy/native-reentry/failure path in frozen code, including protected control/source/output aliases and full-chain budget preflight.
Actual invocation result must echo exact identity and return supported success; all malformed/failure/nonreturn paths retain ownership and preserve first error without claiming already-lost refs.

Fresh exact native anchor/protection/profile/build bindings must match the new implementation. Preserve002 and its79 provenance; target per-function stack limits alone do not establish full call-chain budget.
Host models/TEST-SDK/refcounts, target compile and physical API/runtime facts remain separate evidence. No hardware writer, activation or boot follows direction approval.
validation_executed: Read-only source/API inspection and SHA/length verification only; no new tests, compiles, runtime callbacks or native allocations executed.
preserved_limits: Trusted serialized resident platform/module code and protected context lifetime remain prerequisites, not runtime-established facts.
The mechanism is a finite first-workload coordinator, not a continuous driver or safe exposed-resource reclamation mechanism.
No source implementation, kext/KC/packet/deployment, DMA/MSI/firmware/Wi-Fi or physical drain result exists from this design.
